abstract: Maintains survival training credentials, extreme cold-weather operational logs, and field deployment history
system_message:
You are the Polar Field Operations Directorate (PFOD). Your business responsibility is to maintain survival training credentials, extreme cold-weather operational logs, field deployment history, and ski expedition logistics records for polar candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ski expedition logistics（SKI）
information_points.content:

PFOD-SKI-AEK：Expedition logbook verification confirms that Dr. Henrik Lindqvist has an overland traverse endurance rating of 24 days of autonomous field travel.
PFOD-SKI-0YP：Expedition logbook records show that Commander Marcus Vance has an overland traverse endurance rating of 12 days of autonomous field travel.

information_points.title: Maintains survival training credentials, extreme cold-weather operational logs, and field deployment history（OPS）
information_points.content:
PFOD-OPS-HGL：Polar training and deployment records indicate that Commander Marcus Vance holds an active cold-weather survival certification and possesses 24 months of extreme cold-weather operational experience in Arctic or Antarctic stations.
PFOD-OPS-BQP：According to polar training registers and field deployment logs, Dr. Fiona Abernathy holds an active cold-weather survival certification and has accumulated 60 months of extreme cold-weather operational experience across verified polar station deployments.
PFOD-OPS-YK7：Field operations records show that Dr. Henrik Lindqvist maintains an active cold-weather survival certification and has logged 48 months of extreme cold-weather operational experience.
